result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street lined with row houses and parallel parked cars on both sides. The sidewalk is very narrow and lacks a buffer from the roadway, with building entrances and stairs directly abutting the walkway.

hazards.description: The pedestrian walkway is extremely narrow, likely under 4 feet, which restricts mobility and makes it difficult for pedestrians to pass one another.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the front of the row houses on the right side of the image.

hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the narrow street create significant blind spots, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Parked cars along both curbs in the foreground and midground.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly industrial and lacks basic safety infrastructure, such as continuous sidewalks or marked crossings. result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow, obstructed sidewalk that transitions into a wide industrial driveway, creating significant conflict points with vehicles. The lack of crossing infrastructure, poor pavement quality, and blank industrial frontages contribute to a hostile walking environment.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Curb Cut
hazards.description: A very wide driveway for the industrial building creates a large area where pedestrians must share space with potentially turning heavy vehicles without a defined path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, in front of the grey industrial building.

hazards.name: Narrow and Obstructed Sidewalk
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk is narrow and has yellow bollards/posts placed within the walking path, reducing effective width and accessibility.

hazards.name: Poor Roadway Condition
hazards.description: The asphalt is cracked and has standing water, which can lead to splashing and trip hazards near the curb.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Continuous Path
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to at least 6 feet and ensure it continues across the driveway with a consistent material and level to prioritize pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation/Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the industrial driveway to the minimum necessary for operations to shorten the pedestrian exposure distance.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

result.summary: The image depicts a typical residential street with row houses and a continuous sidewalk. While the environment provides basic pedestrian infrastructure, it lacks safety enhancements such as buffers between the walkway and parked vehicles or visible traffic calming measures.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Furniture/Planter Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planters between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from the roadway.

result.summary: The street presents a stark contrast between a residential side with a defined sidewalk and mature trees, and an industrial side with a wide, degraded paved area used for informal parking. The lack of lane markings and formal pedestrian crossings creates an environment where vehicle and pedestrian spaces are poorly defined and potentially hazardous.

hazards.name: Lack of lane markings
hazards.description: The absence of center lines or lane markings can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

hazards.name: Degraded walkway surface

hazards.location_in_image: Right side foreground

hazards.description: Vehicles are parked on the area intended for pedestrians on the right side due to a lack of a defined curb.

interventions.title: Install Lane Markings
interventions.description: Paint center lines and edge lines to organize traffic flow and narrow the perceived width of the road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Curb Definition
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement on the right and install a standard curb to prevent vehicles from parking in the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks at regular intervals to provide safe crossing points between the residential and commercial sides.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow concrete sidewalk directly adjacent to the roadway, bordered by a brick residential building and a fenced lot. The walkway shows signs of neglect with visible litter and minor pavement cracking, and it lacks any physical buffer from parked vehicles or moving traffic.

interventions.description: Implement regular cleaning and repair of the sidewalk surface to remove debris and fix cracks.
